title: Skin Care for Hyderabad Weather: A Routine for Dry Heat, Monsoon and Cool Winters
ex: Dry heat, strong sun, a moderate monsoon, cool dry winters and borewell water: how to keep a simple skin care routine for Hyderabad weather.
rt: Skin Care for Hyderabad Weather: Dry-Heat Routine | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care for Hyderabad weather: daily sunscreen, moisture for dry air, borewell water, bike commutes, AC offices and cool dry winters, made simple.
quick: Hyderabad's air is drier than coastal cities for much of the year, with very hot summers and cool, dry winters. Skin usually does best with a gentle face wash, a moisturiser on slightly damp skin, a broad-spectrum sunscreen every morning and a little more night cream in winter.
facts: Hyderabad sits on the Deccan plateau, so the air is mostly dry
Summers (March to May) are very hot
Many homes use hard borewell or tanker water
Winter mornings are cool and dry
